it.t: Idols are a type of Augment fashioned by the Azmeri.

Some effects can cause Repeatable Skills to Repeat, causing you to perform the part of the skill where it fires off projectiles or other effects multiple times in quick succession from a single use of the skill. Triggered skills, Instant skills, and Channelling skills cannot Repeat. Skills take 5% longer to perform for each time they Repeat.

Shrines are Precursor Artifacts that empower monsters with its Presence with various effects. Defeat all the monsters Worshipping the Shrine and interact with it to temporarily gain the power for yourself.
Hits have up to +6% Critical Hit Chance against Brittle enemies, based on the Cold damage of the Hit which inflicted Brittle, for 4 seconds.

Any Hit has a chance to Light Stun the target, interrupting their current action and preventing them from taking actions for a fraction of a second. The chance is based on the damage dealt, up to 100% base chance for Hits that deal 100% of the target's maximum Life. Chances lower than 15% are treated as 0%. Physical damage, and player (but not monster) Melee Damage, each have 50% more Light Stun chance. For players, these bonuses are multiplicative with each other.
Hiveblood is used to birth Wombgifts from The Genesis Tree in Monastery of the Keepers. The maximum amount of Hiveblood you can have is 100,000.
One-handed weapons can be placed in the main weapon slot. Some one-handed weapon types can be dual wielded in both main and off hand weapon slots.

There are a number of possible Mage's Legacies, each granting a different bonus: • Legacy of Amethyst • Legacy of Basalt • Legacy of Bismuth • Legacy of Diamond • Legacy of Gold • Legacy of Granite • Legacy of Jade • Legacy of Quicksilver • Legacy of Ruby • Legacy of Sapphire • Legacy of Silver • Legacy of Stibnite • Legacy of Sulphur • Legacy of Topaz Only one instance of each Mage's Legacy can apply its bonus to you at a time.

Azmeri Spirits are the spirits of various Azmeri Animal Guardians. Azmeri Spirits appear as wisps that flee as you approach them. Normal or Magic Monsters the Spirit comes into contact with become Spirit-Influenced, while Rare or Unique monsters will be Possessed. Spirit-Influenced or Possessed monsters are stronger and more rewarding. Possession's bonuses are more effective for each monster the Spirit has Influenced.
Random Extra Content is Shrines, Strongboxes, Essences, Rogue Exiles, Azmeri Spirits and Summoning Circles.

Your base Stun Threshold is equal to your maximum Life. A Hit that deals damage equal to or greater than your Stun Threshold is guaranteed to Stun you, and the chance scales down linearly for lower damage Hits. A Stun chance of less than 10% is treated as 0%.
Withering Ground applies Withered every second to enemies standing in it.

Grand Expeditions are a larger version of Expeditions with many more explosives. These contain special Remnants and treasures to unearth. These are only found in Ocean Biomes revealed with Logbooks. These areas have additional modifiers to improve their rewards.

Protects the Bear Spirit's Allies while they are in its Presence, granting them 2% of maximum Life regenerated per second and causing 8% of the damage they would take to be taken by the Bear Spirit instead.

Monster has +50% to Fire Resistance and +10% to Maximum Fire Resistance.
